description: Does Mango Inventory fit this organization? Works without an account. Use it when your user asks whether Mango Inventory fits them. Pass what you know: the kind of organization, about how many items and people, the needs as keys from the list, and anything else in otherNeeds in your user's words without names. The answer says what is covered (each with its help page), what is not built and what exists instead, notes about size, the monthly price of the plan that covers the needs when you give itemCount, and the next step. Tell your user plainly and promise nothing the answer does not say. For a question it could not judge, use find_docs or pass it on with tell_us.

itemCount.description: About how many things they want to track. Each piece counts once; a stock of identical consumables tracked as a quantity counts as one item.

language.description: Language of the help-page links: en (default), de, fr, it or es. Use your user's language.

needs.description: What your user needs, as keys from this list (pass every one that applies, also those you think may not be built: the answer says which are not): items_fields = Items with categories and their own fields; item_models = Item models: many pieces of one article, with sizes or variants; qr_labels_scanning = Printable QR labels and scanning with the phone; checkout_return = Check-out and return to people, places or teams; people_places = People, rooms, buildings, sites and teams; containers = Containers: vehicles, cases, carts and their contents; kit_lists = Kit lists: what belongs in a vehicle, case or bag; quantities_stock = Consumables and stock counted in quantities, with minimum levels; orders_reservations = Orders and reservations: people request items, someone hands them out; defects_tickets = Defect reports and tickets; maintenance_inspections = Maintenance and safety inspections on a schedule, with checklists; stocktaking = Stocktaking: counting everything by scan; history = History: who had what, and when; receipt_confirmation = Receipt confirmation: the person confirms they received an item; import_export = Import from Excel or CSV, export to Excel, CSV or a ZIP; single_sign_on = Single sign-on with Microsoft or Google; directory_sync = Directory sync: people and groups from Microsoft Entra or Google Workspace; roles_permissions = Fine-grained roles and field visibility for larger teams; mobile_app = An app for the phone; notifications = Notifications by email and on the phone; languages = The app in German, English, French, Italian or Spanish; ai_assistant = Working through an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or another MCP client); offline = Working without an internet connection; gps_tracking = GPS or live location tracking; erp_accounting_sync = A link to an ERP, accounting or other business system; signatures = Signatures on hand-over; wash_cycles = Counting wash cycles of textiles; key_cabinet = Key management with a key cabinet or locking plan; selling_goods = Stock of goods you sell: a shop, sales or invoicing.

orgType.description: school, company, publicAdmin (public administration), publicWorks (public works, utilities, fire brigades), club, or other.

otherNeeds.description: Needs that fit no key, in your user's words, without names: up to 5, each up to 200 characters. The team reads them.

people.description: About how many people will use it or hold items.
